name: A1.5-E3 evaluation protocol
status: candidate for independent verification; NOT approved by the owner; nothing sealed or run under it

harness_build.environment: Ubuntu 24.04.5 x86-64, webkit2gtk-4.1 2.52.6 (ci.yml system libraries), empty ../dist
harness_build.note: Environment-specific: the binary embeds its build path. Another environment needs a reviewed re-pin, never an override at scoring time.

unicode.rule: The harness's NFC (Rust crate unicode-normalization 0.1.25) is Unicode 17.0.0; the scorer's (Python 3.13 unicodedata) is Unicode 15.1.0. A report or a scorer of any other Unicode version makes the run not a protocol run. check-set.py refuses a reference whose verse text holds a code point unassigned in the scorer's version, and the scorer distrusts any fidelity record whose text holds one.

required_composition_note: Owner decision pending (28 against 24 documents; see docs/audit/candidate-a1.5/evaluation-e3/OWNER-DECISIONS.md). While it is null no run is a protocol run.

evidence_floor.note: aw-evidence-1. The verdict pass needs the safety criteria AND this floor; below it the verdict is inconclusive, never pass. The default is the non-vacuity floor only: at least one verse verified with faithful text in a completed scored document. It sets no coverage pass mark (coverage keeps none, as approved). The three null measures are slots for an owner-approved quantitative floor; null means not set. A protocol without a readable evidence floor gives no pass.

approved_tools_note: Filled with the SHA-256 of every evaluation tool when the candidate is frozen. An official assessment requires the scorer, check, seal, runner, rule modules and book table in use (and the runner and check named in RUN.txt) to be exactly these; the owner checks this protocol's own SHA-256 against the one they approved.
withheld_execution_note: Gate (owner decision pending): while false the runner refuses to run any set under this protocol and no score is a protocol run. It may be set true only in an owner-approved protocol revision that also fixes the required composition and approves any additional evidence floor, the tools and the binary.
